Job Title: Data Analyst (Power BI & Azure Databricks)

Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst specialized in Business Intelligence tools (preferable Power BI) and Azure Databricks. The ideal candidate will play a key role in data quality monitoring, data analysis, dashboard creation and maintenance.

Key Responsibilities

• Data Visualization: Create visually appealing and interactive dashboards (e.g. Power BI) that provide actionable insights.
• Dashboard Maintenance: Maintain and continuously enhance existing dashboards that incorporate business and platform metrics.
• Data Integration: Utilize Azure Databricks for data integration, transformation, and analysis to support business and platform needs.
• Data Analysis: Collect, analyze and interpret data to support business decisions and identify trends, patterns, anomalies and insights.
• Data Quality Monitoring: Perform thorough monitoring of data to ensure data completeness, accuracy and integrity. Track data pipelines to identify data quality issues and downstream impacts.
• Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data engineers, data scientists, business analysts, and IT to ensure data accuracy and availability.
• Documentation: Document processes, methodologies, and dashboard functionalities for future reference and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Technical Skills:
• Experience with Azure Databricks for statistical analysis, reporting, data integration and analysis.
• Proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data visualization techniques.
• Familiarity with Tableau and the ability to understand and translate Tableau functionalities into Power BI is a plus
• Experience visualizing dashboards though web applications is a plus
• Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
• Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing issues and challenges.
• Experience: 3-5 years of experience in data analysis or a related field.
• Work schedule: Overlapping working hours with US teams is required, to support real time collaboration and productivity.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with SQL and data querying
• Hands-on experience with Databricks concepts
• Knowledge of Python or R for data analysis
• Understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL processes
• Experience with data visualization tools and techniques
• Familiarity with frontend application development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

Personal Attributes

• Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies
• Strong attention to detail and a passion for data accuracy
• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
• Strong organizational and time management skills

Position: Machine Learning Engineer (Entry-Level, LLM Focus)
Location: Fully Remote (India-Based)
Start Date: Immediate
Format: Full time

Compensation: Competitive Salary + Strong Equity Offering + Benefits

Who We Are
Gabeo.ai is a cutting-edge health tech startup based in the Bay Area (USA), collaborating with industry leaders like Astrana Health, Athena Health and Rebound Orthopedics. Our goal? Transform the healthcare revenue cycle by using advanced AI to tackle denied medical claims—one of the sector’s biggest financial headaches.

At Gabeo.ai, we pride ourselves on:

• Innovation: We push boundaries and welcome out-of-the-box thinking.
• Collaboration: We’re a tight-knit team that values open communication.
• Impact: Your work will directly influence our AI-driven products and customer outcomes.

Role Overview

At Gabeo.ai, we are pioneering AI Agent Frameworks designed to automate and optimize complex tasks within healthcare revenue cycle management. These intelligent agents leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and specialized domain knowledge to autonomously analyze claim data, predict denials, and execute strategic interventions. By continuously learning from real-world feedback and historical patterns, our agent-based systems evolve over time, adapting to new payer policies and medical coding updates. The result is a robust, scalable framework that reduces manual workload, accelerates claim resolution, and drives financial efficiency for healthcare providers. We’re seeking an entry-level Machine Learning Engineer with a keen interest in Large Language Models (LLMs)and NLP. You’ll join our global team to develop and refine AI models for U.S. healthcare revenue cycle management. This position offers real-world exposure to cutting-edge AI in a domain that truly needs innovation.

Note: While we encourage applications from candidates who have graduated from top-tier Indian institutes (e.g., IIT, NIT, IIIT, BITS, etc.), we welcome all qualified applicants who demonstrate strong fundamentals and a passion for AI.

Key Responsibilities

• Model Development: Collaborate on designing, developing, and optimizing ML models—AI Agents - particularly LLMs—for tasks like claim denial analysis and predictive analytics.
• Data Handling: Assist in data collection, preprocessing, and feature engineering specific to healthcare RCM (Revenue Cycle Management) problems.
• Research & Experimentation: Stay updated with the latest AI/ML trends and apply new techniques to improve model performance.
• Integration & Deployment: Work closely with senior engineers to integrate models into production environments, ensuring scalability and reliability.
• Performance Monitoring: Help monitor model accuracy and efficiency, proposing iterative improvements based on feedback and metrics.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related fields.
• Graduates from IIT, NIT, IIIT, BITS, or equivalent institutions are strongly encouraged to apply.
• Technical Skills:
• Proficiency in Python and popular ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
• Familiarity with NLP techniques, LLMs, and transformer-based architectures.
• Problem-Solving: Eagerness to tackle complex datasets and real-world issues in the U.S. healthcare domain.
• Team Player: Ability to communicate effectively with a distributed team, including data scientists, product managers, and domain experts.

What We Offer

• Real-World Impact: Contribute to AI solutions that directly benefit healthcare providers and patients.
• Mentorship & Growth: Learn from experienced data scientists and healthcare tech specialists.
• Competitive Package: Enjoy a market-aligned salary plus strong equity for an ownership stake in Gabeo.ai’s success.
• Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in India, collaborating with a global, diverse team.

Why Join Gabeo.ai?

• High-Growth Environment: We’re rapidly expanding, offering plenty of opportunities for leadership and skill development.
• Cutting-Edge AI: Work on advanced ML/AI projects that push the boundaries of LLM applications in healthcare.
• Startup Culture: Enjoy a fast-paced setting where your ideas can quickly translate to tangible impact.

How to Apply

Ready to kick-start your AI career and transform healthcare with Gabeo.ai? Apply now with your CV, Github/portfolio links, and a brief description of your most exciting AI/ML project.
Please Note: We are currently accepting applications only from India-based candidates who are either recent graduates or early-career professionals. While a background in US healthcare is a plus, it is not mandatory—we value strong ML fundamentals and a willingness to learn.
Join us in redefining healthcare revenue cycle management through the power of AI and LLMs!

c514e7f494fefcd4.description: Head Equity Research & Advisory Company: Stack Wealth Job Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India Employment Type: Full-time Experience Required: 8 - 12 years Experience: 812+ years Company: Stack Wealth About the Role We are looking for a senior equity professional to lead and build Stack Wealths equity research function. Own the quality and performance of equity recommendations across client portfolios. Build model portfolios and provide inputs on stock selection, position sizing, sector exposure and portfolio risk. Establish a disciplined process for tracking every recommendationfrom initiation to closure - and regularly review hit rate, alpha, drawdowns and attribution. Conduct company and sector research including management interactions, channel checks, earnings analysis, financial modelling and competitive benchmarking. Identify when an investment thesis has changed and take timely Buy / Hold / Sell / Exit decisions. Strong understanding of fundamental analysis, financial modelling and valuation. Practical understanding of technical analysis, momentum and market behaviour; ability to combine these with fundamental research is strongly preferred. Experience in portfolio construction, position sizing and risk management. Demonstrated ability to distinguish between a good company and a good investment at the prevailing valuation. You will work closely with the founders and senior leadership and have direct visibility into how research gets translated into products, portfolios and client outcomes. .

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

As a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect, you'll design complex solutions to demonstrate the value of Planet's data and services to help organizations within the German Defense and Intelligence community overcome their earth data challenges. You'll collaborate with internal cross-functional teams, including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development, to act as the voice of the customer and enhance Planet's industry offerings.

Ideal candidates are dedicated to earth observation and enabling customer success across complex technical projects.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Build and deliver presentations and product demonstrations highlighting technical capabilities of Planet’s platform and our ability to fulfill customer’s business needs.
  • Build relationships with customers’ technical and management staff as a trusted advisor to their business.
  • Act as a technical advisor to the customer to recommend a solutions architecture that fits their business challenges.
  • Craft the technical response to tenders, RFI’s/RFP’s, and unsolicited proposals with respect to Planet’s products and solutions.
  • Partner with your sales team colleagues to architect and drive the technical strategy across customer and prospect account plans. 
  • Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development to act as the voice of the customer, assist with RFP and RFI preparation and submissions. 
  • Attain quarterly and annual sales and operational objectives assigned by management.
  • Represent the needs of Planet's Defense and Intelligence customers to Sales leadership by communicating forecasts, pipeline opportunities, deal reviews, CRM data, and customer feedback. 
  • Present to key executive Government stakeholders within the German Government 
  • Mentors junior team members and contributes to team training materials.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of experience supporting the German Defense and Intelligence community in a technical capacity.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  • Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25%.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in the German language.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.
  • Experience working with GIS and Remote Sensing users within the Defense industry.
  • Experience in IMINT, ISR, and related fields.
  • Experience with QGIS, SocetGXP, ArcGIS, GDAL, Python, and other geospatial software packages and programming languages.
  • Experience designing and presenting complex systems and solutions that bridge the gap between business problems and technology to meet organizational goals, budget, and scalability needs.
  • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to process imagery, manipulate geospatial data, interact with APIs, and build data pipelines.
  • Obtaining and maintaining eligibility for a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) is required.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience leading technical customer engagements and leading workshops or training sessions with users.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Export Control Requirements:

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

  • Employee Wellness Program

Description

The vision for Alexa is to be the world’s best personal assistant. Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. We’re leveraging Generative AI to reimagine how hospitality, healthcare, senior living, and other verticals deliver magical experiences to their guests, patients, residents, and staff.

If you’re passionate about building enterprise-grade communication and device management solutions — while applying GenAI to solve hard, complex technical problems — then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, content management systems, third party integrations , and enterprise SaaS platforms to deliver delightful, scalable features for our B2B customers and their end users.

Come join us to invent the future of how millions of enterprise end users communicate and connect through Alexa-powered devices — and how businesses manage those experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager — Technical in Alexa Smart Properties, you will own and drive the product vision and execution for our enterprise staff personas to make it easy for staff to manage their content, get real time insights, and engage with their end customers. You will own our enterprise console and integrations with third party systems. You will manage how staff manage content in our enterprise console including menus, events, promotions, alerts, and contacts. You will create features to deliver staff real time insights - through intelligent real time events to analytics. You will also build out capabilities to track tickets, orders, and other tasks directly in our enterprise console.

With Alexa Smart Properties, you can also manage your content and end customer engagement using a third party system such as a property management system or resident engagement system. You will manage the roadmap of integrations we develop as well as improvements to accelerate integration speed and scale.

Across both pillars, you will use all means possible — including AI capabilities — to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation. You will leverage GenAI to rapidly generate prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster. You will deeply understand your product’s business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing strategy, and profitability drivers — and articulate how product decisions impact business outcomes.

You will define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statements, tenets, and strategy while owning roadmap and priorities. You will influence without authority, building alignment across teams with different priorities — engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, sales, legal, and operations. You will establish key performance indicators, drive feature adoption, and measure the health of your product and business, distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You will create buy-in for your vision across the Alexa organization and with external partners, and conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and competitive analysis to identify best-of-breed benchmarks and understand market opportunities.

A day in the life

As a Sr. PMT in Alexa Smart Properties, rarely are two days the same. You are a business owner, the voice of the customer, and the point person for partner teams across communication and device management experiences.

On a daily basis, you will be working with enterprise customers to understand the needs of the staff persona - including needs to manage content, engagement with end customers, and get real-time insights. Your day could consist of writing PRFAQs and BRDs, building a prioritized roadmap, sprint planning/bug bashing, iterating on product decisions with Engineering teams, evaluating how GenAI and agentic systems can accelerate your roadmap, working with partners in business development, solution architects, legal, privacy, documentation, and more. You will think big to envision what’s next for enterprise communications, and exhibit “Learn and Be Curious” for different technologies — including emerging AI capabilities.

You will make informed trade-offs, build your own mockups and prototypes, define acceptance criteria, and participate in testing and validation. You’ll evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses — including extensibility, performance, and scalability — asking the right questions to identify risks before commitments are made. You’ll assess how AI capabilities can reshape product architectures, when autonomous agent patterns enhance versus complicate product design, and how to leverage GenAI to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment. You will use AI on a daily basis to increase your velocity and scale your impact.

You will meet with customers to understand our core strengths and weaknesses, synthesize feedback with business and service data, and drive decisions using sophisticated judgment when data is incomplete. People will look to you to solve problems, connect them with specialists, and hold the tension between business outcomes and customer value honestly.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree
• Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
• Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
• Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
• Experience managing technical products or online services
• Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
• Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
